name: session-tts
description: Read Claude Code-related audio cues locally with a different Japanese voice per session. The Stop hook speaks only the end-of-turn final paragraph (Claude's wrap-up summary) so the audio stays short; mid-turn progress is narrated by Claude via /session-tts:say, nudged by reminder hooks (TodoWrite/Monitor/Agent/UserPromptSubmit). Permission prompts are narrated with the workspace name. ON by default; engine and models managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.
